parts.t: Grandview-Woodland is one of Vancouver's most beloved neighbourhoods — home to the legendary Commercial Drive, a hub of cafés, restaurants, and independent shops. With beautiful heritage homes, a progressive community vibe, and easy transit access, it consistently ranks among the most desirable places to live in the city.
